title: Who is an accredited investor (Rule 501(a))
rule: Accredited investors include natural persons with net worth over $1,000,000, alone or with a spouse or spousal equivalent, excluding the primary residence, or income over $200,000, or $300,000 jointly, in each of the last two years and expected this year; Series 7, 65 or 82 holders in good standing; the issuer's directors, executive officers and general partners; entities over $5,000,000 in assets or investments not formed to buy the securities; and entities whose equity owners are all accredited.
changeWatch: Amendments to Rule 501(a), new SEC orders designating professional credentials, or legislation changing the definition.
